extension.summary: Backup and restore LibreELEC system settings and configurations
extension.description: Automatically backup and restore your LibreELEC system settings, configurations, and addons. Supports local and remote storage locations with smart backup rotation.
extension.disclaimer: This addon is not affiliated with LibreELEC or Kodi.
extension.news:
v1.5.3 (2026-10-28) - Added SSH key authentication for SFTP remote backups, including optional key passphrase. - Added interactive SFTP remote browsing and a built-in CLI backend for environments where paramiko cannot be imported. - Bundled paramiko and dependencies for common architectures. - Added a toggle to use native Kodi dialogs instead of the custom GUI.
v1.5.2 (2026-10-27) - Added optional Kodi video database backups using a consistent SQLite snapshot, including WAL data. - Restore detects database versions, validates integrity, and preserves an existing database of the same or newer version.
v1.5.0 (2026-04-12) - FEATURE RELEASE - Added custom dashboard and backup browser windows with skin XML layouts. - New custom settings/help details for better guidance. - Added backup summary popup toggle in Notifications. - Remote storage usage now visible on dashboard. - Improved restore UX with reliable progress and less notification noise. - Detailed, colorized operation summaries added. - Improved backup detection and date parsing for all naming formats. - Hardened restore handling for file permission/path errors. - Cleaned up Remote Settings Test Connection diagnostics. - Switched all popups to custom GUI dialogs with fallback support. - Fixed Credits display and settings navigation edge cases. - Automatic mounting/unmounting of addons directory during restore.
